events.en: A Norwegian helicopter chases a husky across the ice
events.sk: Nórsky vrtuľník prenasleduje po ľade huskyho

events.en: The dog reaches Outpost 31. A Norwegian opens fire; Garry shoots him
events.sk: Pes dobehne na stanicu 31. Nór strieľa, Garry ho zastrelí

events.en: MacReady and Copper fly to the Norwegian camp
events.sk: MacReady a Copper letia do nórskeho tábora

events.en: The dog walks the station alone and enters a room where a man sits in shadow
events.sk: Pes sa sám prechádza stanicou a vojde do izby, kde v tieni sedí muž

events.en: Norwegian camp: burned, empty, a block cut from the ice, a two-faced corpse
events.sk: Nórsky tábor: spálený, prázdny, vysekaný blok ľadu, mŕtvola s dvoma tvárami

events.en: Blair's autopsy: 'a normal set of internal organs'
events.sk: Blairova pitva: „normálne vnútorné orgány“

events.en: Kennel: the dog splits open and attacks the other dogs
events.sk: Psinec: pes sa roztvorí a napadne ostatné psy

events.en: Childs burns the creature with a flamethrower
events.sk: Childs spáli tvora plameňometom

events.en: Blair: 'It imitates them perfectly'
events.sk: Blair: „Imituje ich dokonale“

events.en: Flight to the crater: a ship buried in ice for 100,000 years
events.sk: Let ku kráteru: loď v ľade najmenej 100 000 rokov

events.en: Blair's computer: 75 % chance someone is already infected
events.sk: Blairov počítač: 75 % šanca, že niekto už je nakazený

events.en: Bennings is assimilated alone in the storeroom
events.sk: Benningsa asimiluje Vec, keď je sám v sklade

events.en: The Bennings-Thing is burned in the snow
events.sk: Bennings-Vec horí v snehu

events.en: Blair wrecks the radio, the helicopter and kills the dogs
events.sk: Blair zničí rádio, vrtuľník a zabije psy

events.en: Blair is locked in the toolshed
events.sk: Blaira zamknú v kôlni

events.en: Someone has destroyed the blood supply
events.sk: Niekto zničil zásobu krvi

events.en: Garry gives up command; MacReady takes over
events.sk: Garry sa vzdá velenia, preberá ho MacReady

events.en: 'Storm's been hitting us hard now for 48 hours'
events.sk: „Búrka nás bije už 48 hodín“

events.en: Lights out in the lab for an hour. Fuchs disappears
events.sk: V laboratóriu hodinu nesvieti svetlo. Fuchs zmizne

events.en: Fuchs is found burned in the snow
events.sk: Fuchsa nájdu spáleného v snehu

events.en: MacReady and Nauls go up to the shack, 40–45 minutes unseen
events.sk: MacReady a Nauls idú k chatrči, 40–45 minút ich nikto nevidí

events.en: Nauls cuts MacReady loose: torn clothes found in his furnace
events.sk: Nauls odreže MacReadyho od lana: v jeho peci našiel roztrhané šaty

events.en: MacReady breaks back in with dynamite
events.sk: MacReady sa vráti dnu s dynamitom

events.en: Norris' chest opens; his head grows legs and walks away
events.sk: Norrisov hrudník sa otvorí, hlave narastú nohy a odkráča

events.en: Clark lunges with a scalpel and is shot
events.sk: Clark sa vrhne so skalpelom a padne zastrelený

events.en: The blood test
events.sk: Krvný test

events.en: Palmer's blood leaps from the dish — Palmer is a Thing
events.sk: Palmerova krv vyskočí z misky — Palmer je Vec

events.en: Childs is tested. The dish is out of view
events.sk: Test Childsa. Obsah misky nevidno

events.en: MacReady leaves Childs alone guarding the entrance
events.sk: MacReady nechá Childsa samého strážiť vchod

events.en: Blair's toolshed is empty: a tunnel and a ship built from helicopter parts
events.sk: Blairova kôlňa je prázdna: tunel a loď z dielov vrtuľníka

events.en: A hooded figure with a flamethrower at the main entrance
events.sk: Postava v kapucni s plameňometom pri hlavnom vchode

events.en: Lights out. 'He got back inside and blew the generator'
events.sk: Tma. „Dostal sa dnu a vyhodil generátor“

events.en: Blair, still in human form, attacks Garry
events.sk: Blair, ešte v ľudskej podobe, napadne Garryho

events.en: MacReady blows up the Blair-Thing — and the station
events.sk: MacReady vyhodí do vzduchu Blair-Vec aj stanicu

events.en: Childs walks back out of the dark
events.sk: Childs sa vynorí z tmy

events.en: The bottle. Both men laugh
events.sk: Fľaša. Obaja sa zasmejú
